# Crayola Washable Watercolor Paints, 8 Primary Colors (Pack of 4)

## Bright Colors for Young Painters

Give young artists a vibrant painting experience with Crayola Washable Watercolor Paints. This four-pack includes four pans, each holding eight popular colors and a paintbrush, so kids can start creating right away. Each pan delivers vivid color with just a small amount of water.

## Easy Cleanup, Less Stress

Painting time can get messy, but these washable watercolors help keep it manageable. Their special formula is designed to wash easily from skin and fabrics, making them a practical choice for classrooms, art projects, and home use. Teachers and parents can spend less time on cleanup and more time on creativity.

## Built for Hands-On Creativity

Kids can blend and mix colors with the included brush to explore new shades and create their own palettes. The sturdy brushes are built for repeated use, and the set gives children of all ages a dependable way to develop their artistic skills.

## Stock Up for the Classroom or Home

Whether you're equipping a classroom or preparing art supplies for your own children, this value-priced four-pack has you covered. Add it to your cart today and give young artists the tools to paint, play, and learn.
